independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored none of the DG7 candidate: no implementation, test, ADR or amendment, handover text, register row, release tool, drill, decision (D-242 to D-282) or stages.json change. My verdict comes from my own runs in this session on the frozen tree and a disposable clone of source_commit 152db5b5 (removed afterwards). I did not open any other reviewer's round-2 record or evidence. I read my role's own round-1 record and findings sidecar (as the reporter of F-DG7-1001/1002) and the DO-D11 and SA-ADR71 handbacks.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the assignment hash, HEAD, the recomputed candidate id and the manifest diff; list commits between source_commit and HEAD.
checks_run.command: sha256sum docs/delivery/assignments/DG7/round-2/domain-reviewer.md; git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 --diff docs/delivery/candidates/DG7/33266ccd9ce4ec44.manifest.json; git log --oneline 152db5b5..HEAD; git diff --stat 152db5b5 HEAD
checks_run.expected: Assignment hash ffffe108…; candidate sha256:33266ccd… with 3158 files; --diff matches; HEAD differs from source_commit only by excluded freeze metadata.
checks_run.actual: Assignment hash matches. candidate_id sha256:33266ccd9ce4ec4475de745ebacfaafbd2f25870f8be966086f4a74578b7259c, 3158 files, exit 0; --diff matches: true, no added/removed/changed file, exit 0. HEAD is 1c119c031, two commits after 152db5b51 (c26f69d70 freeze, 1c119c031 assignments and REVIEWING, as the assignment discloses). They touch only the three round-2 assignments, the manifest and stages.json, all excluded from the candidate. --pipeline (DOM-RG2-01) accepts 152db5b5 as the round's source_commit. Two assignment contradictions, recorded rather than guessed: (1) it asks for 'round: 7', but the record directory and the stages.json round entry are round 2 and the validator (rules.mjs l.682, l.794) requires rec.round to equal the round, so I write 2; (2) the template it names, docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-7/domain-reviewer.json, does not exist (DG5 has rounds 1-5), so I mirrored the review schema and my role's DG7 round-1 record.

checks_run.procedure: Historical validation of DG6..DG1, --pipeline, --stage DG7, --register DG7; validator unit tests in the clone (judges the D-282 findings-schema change).
checks_run.command: for s in DG6 DG5 DG4 DG3 DG2 DG1: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage $s; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --pipeline; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG7; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG7; (clone) node --test tools/gates/tests/*.test.mjs
checks_run.environment: frozen tree (validators) and disposable clone at 152db5b5 (tests); Node 24.21.0
checks_run.expected: DG1-DG6 historical PASS; pipeline PASS; --stage DG7 fails only for the missing gate record; register PASS; validator tests all pass.
checks_run.actual: PASS gate DG6, DG5, DG4, DG3, DG2, DG1 (historical), each exit 0. 'PASS pipeline (active stage: DG7 REVIEWING)', exit 0. --stage DG7 exits 1 with exactly one problem, 'gate DG7: file not found (docs/delivery/gates/DG7.json)', expected before the audit. 'PASS register rules at DG7', exit 0. Validator tests: 66 tests, 66 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 0 todo, exit 0. Findings schema change (D-282, ^F-DG[0-7]-[0-9]{3,4}$): sound; findings.json holds 221 three-digit and 7 four-digit ids, all valid, and nothing else in the schema changed.

checks_run.procedure: Diff the round-1 source ddf42ccd against 152db5b5 excluding delivery records, and read every changed product, handover, ADR and tool file.
checks_run.command: git diff --stat ddf42ccd 152db5b5 -- . ':!docs/delivery/reviews' ':!docs/delivery/runs' ':!docs/delivery/test-evidence' ':!docs/delivery/candidates' ':!docs/delivery/assignments' ':!docs/delivery/handbacks'; git diff ddf42ccd 152db5b5 -- <each file>
checks_run.expected: Only the DO-D11 and SA-ADR71 repairs and the D-282 records changed; no apps/ or packages/ change.
checks_run.actual: 15 files: deploy/compose/compose.yaml, deploy/scripts/backup.sh and its test, deploy/service-list.json, ADR-0071 (Amendment 1), decisions.md (+D-282), findings.json, stages.json, docs/handover/backup-restore.md (§3.3 permissions, §10 residual, Arabic bullet), known-limitations.md (report-identity line only), security-controls.md (SC-13 note), tools/gates/schemas/findings.schema.json, tools/release/secret-scan.mjs and two release tests. apps/, packages/, the guides, README, operator and deployment guides are unchanged. backup.sh: umask 077, chmod 700 of the set, a refused group/other-writable root (exit 2), backup_owner_only before and in --phase finish, a new ownerOnly check. Compose: no /tmp fallback, long bind syntax with create_host_path: false. secret-scan: isI18nKey narrows the S3 exemption; SC-13 honestly discloses the remaining 64-hex exemption. No stale '/tmp/mth-backups' reference remains outside delivery records. Two consequences raised: F-DG7-1031 (the changed Compose sequence was never run, while the handover says the Compose half is 'recorded' on the orchestrator's host) and F-DG7-1032 (ADR-0063 §1.2 and ADR-0066 §4 not amended for DO-D11; Low).

checks_run.procedure: Run the protocol audit over all stages, compare it with the orchestrator's rg2 report, break down the DG7 hits.
checks_run.command: node tools/release/protocol-audit.mjs --all --json docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/domain/round-2/protocol-audit-dom-rg2.json; node -e <hit-set comparison and per-kind DG7 breakdown>
checks_run.environment: frozen tree with git history, Node 24.21.0
checks_run.expected: Exit 1 by design with only disclosed hits; DG7 hits match D-270/D-282 disclosures.
checks_run.actual: Exit 1 by design: 'FAIL (exit 1): 279 hit(s) in 29 check(s), 0 blocked, 36 pass'. The failing assertions are the hits themselves: every DG0-DG6 hit is a D-249 H1-H11 disclosure (C9 DG0/DG5 are the accepted observation F-DG6-952). DG7: C2 25 (24 assignment-missing-elements, D-269/D-270; 1 assignment-sha-mismatch for ARCH-R6 run a0fbc6f1, now disclosed by D-282), C3 7 (handback-missing-sections, D-270 and the REQ-DLV-012 note), C5 1 (historical-first, disclosed). C1, C4, C6, C7, C8, C9 PASS for DG7. Compared with the orchestrator's protocol-audit-rg2.json the hit sets are equal except the DG7 C5 hit's 'test_evidence_found' list, which includes newer round-1 reviewer evidence files: same hit, same counts. Release-auditor decides the D-270 C2 hits (REQ-DLV-011 later clause).

checks_run.procedure: Secret scan (payload, history), claims scan, release-notes --check, check-handover with my audit and with the orchestrator's rg2 audit, known-limitations --check; regenerate known-limitations from my report in the clone and diff.
checks_run.command: node tools/release/secret-scan.mjs --scope payload; … --scope history; node tools/release/claims-scan.mjs; node tools/release/release-notes.mjs … --check; node tools/release/check-handover.mjs --protocol-audit <mine|rg2>; node tools/release/known-limitations.mjs --protocol-audit <rg2> --check
checks_run.environment: frozen tree; disposable clone for the regeneration; Node 24.21.0
checks_run.expected: All PASS; any non-zero exit explained.
checks_run.actual: secret payload PASS (3158 files; allowed 33; canary 22), exit 0. secret history PASS (36211 files; allowed 219; canary 27), exit 0. claims PASS (891 files; negated 28; allowed 19), exit 0. release-notes: 0 unfinished, 23 later clauses, up to date, exit 0. check-handover with MY audit report: exit 1, 'generated: FAIL … known-limitations differ'. Explained: the generated section embeds the report's repository head and SHA-256; regenerating from my report changes only that identity line (head 1c119c03 vs 38a46712, SHA 25ab0f1e… vs 591ff9fa…), every table row is identical. check-handover with the orchestrator's rg2 report: PASS on all six groups, exit 0; known-limitations --check exit 0. Both runs print 5 warnings 'the Arabic section … lacks the H.3 provisional line under its heading (§2.3)' (release-notes.md l.125/129/133/154, upgrades.md l.227); by design these are advisory (check-handover.mjs l.18, ADR-0071 A1.4 item 8), the same set appears in the orchestrator's prefreeze rg1/rg2 logs, and the Arabic summary blocks carry the provisional line at their top.

checks_run.actual: exit 0 (long-run.txt). The only build.log lines matching error/fail/warn are the asset names UnplacedFieldErrors-….js and FailuresPage-….js and Vite's advisory chunk-size warning; none is an error.

checks_run.procedure: Run my probe (P1 register API equals the CSV; P2 About equals the CSV and the dependency file; P3 rendered register/About in ar (rtl) and en (ltr) with the 'not business approvals' statement and no approval, PMI or branding claim; P4 authorization) plus apps/web/e2e/p7-admin-screens.spec.ts, against the real API on a disposable PostgreSQL.
checks_run.command: (clone) PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers DOM_PROBE_OUT=<evidence>/probe E2E_PG_PORT=32300/32320 E2E_API_PORT=32301/32321 apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh npx playwright test apps/web/e2e/zz-dom-rg2-probe.spec.ts apps/web/e2e/p7-admin-screens.spec.ts --workers=1 --trace off --reporter=list
checks_run.environment: disposable clone, pre-installed Chromium, ports 32300-32349, synthetic dev users
checks_run.expected: All tests pass; register 412 rows, same ids and SHA-256; About 0 open items, 23 later clauses, 11 dependencies; rtl/ltr; AUD 200, no role 403, anonymous 401.
checks_run.actual: First run: 15 passed, 1 failed, exit 1. The failure was 'browserContext.newPage: Target page, context or browser has been closed' inside AxeBuilder.analyze in 'P7 Configuration transfer…' (ar), at 14:54 UTC, when the shared scratch volume was full (0 MB free; my next shell command was refused with 'Disk full'). The surrounding Chromium lines (dbus 'Operation not permitted', 'CreatePlatformSocket() failed: Address family not supported') are sandbox noise present in passing runs too. I freed space by deleting delivery records from my clone and re-ran both files unchanged: 16 passed (2.5 min), exit 0, no failed, skipped or flaky test, no ERROR line. Probe results (en and ar): csvRows = apiRows = snapshotRowCount = 412, csvSha256 = snapshotSha256 = edf229cf…93c0, same ids in order; statusCounts {PLANNED 0, SPECIFIED 0, IMPLEMENTED 412, BLOCKED 0} equal to the CSV; openItems []; laterClauses = the 23 completes-after-gate rows; external dependencies equal to the handover file (Unknown as a status, not 0). dir rtl in Arabic and ltr in English; 'These are engineering delivery states, not business approvals.' / 'هذه حالات تسليم هندسية، وليست موافقات أعمال.' shown on both screens; AUD 200, dev.nobody 403, anonymous 401. p7-admin-screens: axe clean at 1280 and 360 px, keyboard and no-permission states in both languages.

checks_run.actual: Test Files 11 passed (11), Tests 89 passed (89), exit 0, none skipped or failing. Product source is unchanged since round 1, so the round-1 mapping holds: transfer export, config-bundle validate/commit (If-Match 412/428), retention classes PUT (If-Match) and runs POST (Idempotency-Key) each assert 403, 400/422 and audit; register and About are GET only.

checks_run.procedure: Run deploy/scripts/tests/backup-restore.test.mjs (T-E1..T-E12, including the DO-D11 owner-only and refused-root tests) on a disposable PostgreSQL; inspect the Compose half's evidence.
checks_run.command: (clone) QA_PG_PORT=32380 MTH_PORT_POOL=32381-32399 tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh node --test deploy/scripts/tests/backup-restore.test.mjs; grep -rl -e '--profile backup' -e 'phase finish' docs/delivery/test-evidence docs/delivery/decisions.md docs/delivery/progress.md; grep -i backup docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/orchestrator/host/*.log
checks_run.environment: disposable clone, disposable PostgreSQL 16; frozen tree for the evidence search
checks_run.expected: 13/13 pass; the Compose half either run and recorded, or honestly described as not run.
checks_run.actual: tests 13, pass 13, fail 0, skipped 0, exit 0; T-E10 (set owner-only under umask 022), T-E11 (split-phase sequence ends owner-only), T-E12 (1777 and 0770 roots refused, exit 2, nothing written) pass. A19 itself (restore recovers database, evidence, audit, snapshots and job state with documented checks and timings) is met container-free. But no Compose backup/restore run exists in the orchestrator's host logs, prefreeze-rg2, decisions or progress (the only hit is a code-security round-1 reproduction), while backup-restore.md l.76 and l.202 say the Compose half's result 'is recorded' on the orchestrator's host, and DO-D11 changed that sequence and asked for a Compose run. Raised as F-DG7-1031 (Medium). The check itself ran and passed; the finding concerns the documentation and the missing container evidence.

checks_run.procedure: Read the acceptance, status, evidence and notes of the 54 DG7 rows; check every evidence path exists; compare the later-clause rows with About.
checks_run.expected: 54 DG7 rows equal the assigned set; all IMPLEMENTED with existing evidence; Q19 rows carry completes-after-gate and grant no approval.
checks_run.actual: 412 rows, all IMPLEMENTED; 54 DG7 rows equal the assigned set; every evidence path of the 54 rows exists. 23 rows carry 'completes-after-gate:' (equal to About's later clauses); their notes state that the status grants and implies no DG7 or G1-G6 approval and that rejecting the Q19 extension (D-274) BLOCKS the gate. I accept the Q19 extension as disclosed, not as met: the named clauses (release-auditor decisions, seal, live CI, live registry) are outside a reviewer's scope. REQ-DLV-011 notes still give the old-branch C2 counts as dated history (see the F-DG7-1001 verification). Environmental residuals per the assignment, PASS on the offline/config surface: live registry (REQ-DLV-042 AC-1, D-057), live CI (REQ-DLV-025 A24, D-058), Keycloak/real IdP (D-049), external systems through test adapters, and the provisional capacity targets of REQ-S20-029/030.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm guides unchanged since round 1, re-check phases/gates against the playbook and the PMI/brand/approval wording; judge D-249/D-270, D-274, D-278, D-280, D-281, D-282, A27 K11 partial, ADR-0065 Amendment 1, D-267, D-269.
checks_run.command: git diff --stat ddf42ccd 152db5b5 -- docs/handover/guides apps packages …; grep G1..G6 in docs/source/playbook.md and the user guide; grep -i 'PMI|certif|official|0078FF|approv' docs/handover/…
checks_run.expected: Gates match B0023; no PMI certification, official branding or approval claim; disclosures accurate.
checks_run.actual: Guides, apps and packages unchanged since round 1. Playbook l.99-104 (G1 Case for Change … G6 Sustain) match the user guide's G1-G6 list; the guide states a gate decision is not an IT, Finance or engineering approval and that G6 says nothing about the platform's release. EN and AR user guides say the playbook is 'inspired by PMI, Brightline and BRM' and 'not an official PMI standard', the product 'not a certified product'. backup-restore.md states sets and drills are engineering artefacts, not approvals; RPO/RTO are IT's. Disclosures: D-249/D-270 and D-269 match my audit; D-274 (Q19 extension) is stated in each affected row; D-278 is carried in release notes and known-limitations; D-280 now backed by ADR-0071 Amendment 1; D-281's product equivalence was judged in round 1 and the delta since is only the listed repairs; D-282 accurately discloses F-DG7-1001 and F-DG7-1022 (old-branch citations kept as history, not findings of this gate), and its schema change is sound; D-267's host run covers build, bundle, up/readyz, no-egress smoke and Keycloak (run 3b's 4 failures explained by the inherited proxy, 3c 4/4), but not the A19 Compose half (F-DG7-1031); A27 K11 partial (stale progress.md at the checkpoint) and ADR-0065 Amendment 1 (automation_rule not carried) are disclosed in the drill report and known-limitations. No business, Finance, IT or production approval is claimed anywhere I read.

checks_run.procedure: Read the orchestrator's prefreeze-rg2 checks.log and the step exits.
checks_run.expected: 19/19 exit 0, with any error line explained.
checks_run.actual: 19 steps exit 0 (protocol-audit wrapped with '; true' because its exit 1 is by design, see DOM-RG2-03). Two error lines at the top, 'find: The -delete action automatically turns on -depth, but -prune does nothing…', come from the script's cleanup find, not from any check. deploy-tool-tests does not include backup-restore.test.mjs (needs PostgreSQL); I ran it myself (DOM-RG2-08) and DO-D11's evidence 04-backup-restore-tests.log shows 13/13. Live CI not run (environmental residual).

checks_run.procedure: As reporter, verify F-DG7-1001 and F-DG7-1002 on this candidate (verifications sidecar); comment on the other round-1 findings.
checks_run.actual: F-DG7-1001 PASS → CLOSED_VERIFIED (D-282 discloses the ARCH-R6 sha-mismatch; known-limitations' claim is now true; residual stale REQ-DLV-011 counts accepted as dated history). F-DG7-1002 PASS → CLOSED_VERIFIED (ADR-0071 Amendment 1 matches the generator and release notes). Comments only (not my findings, no sidecar entry): F-DG7-1011's isI18nKey narrowing is in place and honestly disclosed in SC-13 (64-hex exemption remains); F-DG7-1012's script half is repaired and tested (T-E10..T-E12 pass in my run), but its Compose half is untested (F-DG7-1031); F-DG7-1013/1021 are the same defect as F-DG7-1002; F-DG7-1022 is disclosed by D-282 as historical citations.

summary: FAIL on one Medium finding; the product itself behaves as required. Candidate verified (sha256:33266ccd…, 3158 files; HEAD differs only by freeze metadata); DG1-DG6 historical and --pipeline PASS; validator tests 66/66. Register and About equal requirements.csv (412 rows, same SHA-256, 0 open items, 23 later clauses, 11 dependencies), Arabic RTL and English LTR, AUD 200 / no role 403 / anonymous 401; P7 integration 89/89; P7 admin e2e plus probe 16/16 on re-run (the first run lost one test to a Chromium crash while the shared disk was full, explained); backup scripts 13/13; secret, claims, release-notes and handover checks PASS. Verified F-DG7-1001 and F-DG7-1002 as CLOSED_VERIFIED. New: F-DG7-1031 (Medium, REQ-S19-012): the handover says the Compose half of backup/restore runs on the orchestrator's host and 'is recorded there', but no such run exists, and DO-D11 changed that Compose sequence without running it. F-DG7-1032 (Low): ADR-0063 §1.2 and ADR-0066 §4 not amended for DO-D11, proposed as an observation. Medium findings must be repaired before the gate (D-192), so the verdict is FAIL. This review grants no business, Finance, IT or production approval and implies neither DG7 nor any G1-G6 approval.
